name: NIXSMART Strategic Discount Manager
author: nixsmart

sections.description:
NIXSMART Strategic Discount Manager provides a streamlined interface to control your WooCommerce store’s pricing strategy without opening every single product page.

In the “Free Version”, you have full control over your product catalog:
1. Product Overview: View a complete list of your products with ID, Title, Type (Simple/Variable), variation counts, and current list prices.
2. Quick Price Adjustment: Increase or decrease the list price of any product by a percentage in seconds.
3. Instant Discounts: Apply percentage discounts directly from the main dashboard.
4. Urgency Timer: Activate a clean, minimal countdown timer for your offers to boost conversion rates on the product page.
5. Fast Saving: Update prices, discounts, and expiry dates for each product with a single click.

Upgrade to PRO Version

Unlock the full power of strategic pricing with the PRO version:
1. Mass Actions & Filters: Apply changes to hundreds of products at once. Filter by Category, Tag, Brand, or Attribute.
2. Automatic Expiry: The system automatically removes offers and timers when the time runs out, restoring the original list price.
3. Backup & Restore: Create full snapshots of your store’s pricing and restore them whenever you need.
4. Sales Statistics: Track units sold, gross revenue, and product views with advanced time-range filters and sorting.
5. Premium Timer Themes: Choose from 10+ exclusive designs for events like Black Friday, Christmas, Halloween, and more.

Find out more: https://www.nixsmart.com/prodotto/nixsmart-strategic-discount-manager/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the NIXSMART SDM menu in your sidebar to manage your products.
sections.faq:
Does the timer appear automatically?

Yes, Once you set a discount and an expiry date in the dashboard, a minimal timer will appear on the product page.

Can I manage variations?

Yes, The free version allows you to see parent products and their variation details, providing a clear overview for your pricing strategy.
